Ownership: write-sets verified disjoint and semantically implementable EXCEPT the pending-tail/question-id linkage (F-1: no workstream owns it, DAG inverted, 'no store-shape changes' collides); the destroy-cascade into shared cached children is unpinned (F-2 — mainline ChatPage->Messenger->cached Message path); the unintentional-Close indicator has no differentiation mechanism and would stick on chat_deleted/leaveChat (F-3, same class as the previous run's F-1). NOTE: Protocol default complete_stream not inherited by structural providers (N-1); per-emit O(n) message re-render remains by design (N-2); bot_delta streaming is per-sender-tab only (N-3). Contract faithfulness otherwise solid: both docs/NEXT.md debt items covered, deferred live acceptance recorded (host down — legal), branch deviation documented, budgets arithmetic consistent, planFiles complete, non-goals honest. Freeze-gating round.
